purpose: Declarative MCP tool contracts for the stable public four-tool protocol and its submit compatibility alias.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Simple static guidance entrypoint for weak/local models. Explains the four-tool protocol without returning the full dynamic workflow packet. Use state for current forms/actions.

topic.description: Optional user topic; currently returned as guidance context.

tools.name: state
tools.description: Return the current public workflow/FSM state packet: allowed forms/actions, next safe action, runtime-profile limits, and optional diagnostics when permitted.

task_id.description: Optional active task id for task-scoped state/context cues.

work_handle.description: Optional public work handle returned by start_task/claim_task; preferred for task-bound continuity.

work_token.description: Legacy continuation token for task-bound continuity; prefer work_handle when available.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Simple read entrypoint for weak/local models. Use ref for public addresses such as task:mnemoforge:<id>, mailbox_get:memory:<project>:<id>, or mailbox_state:<project>:planning; use query for natural read-only questions. The server chooses the safe read route.

query.description: Natural read-only question when no ref is known.

agent_id.description: Optional reading agent identity for task or handoff-scoped packets.

tools.name: submit
tools.description: Simple form-submission entrypoint for weak/local models. Submit a public mailbox form by setting form_id (or action) and payload; the server validates state, guardrails, and ownership before any mutation.

tools.name: put
tools.description: Compatibility alias for submit. Submit a public mailbox form by setting form_id (or action) and payload; the server validates state, guardrails, and ownership before any mutation.

form_id.description: Public form id from help/get mailbox state.
